description: Generic SDMX data fetch from any ECB flow. Key is dot-separated dimension values; empty positions are wildcards. Example: flow_ref="EXR", key="D.USD.EUR.SP00.A" (daily USD/EUR spot).

flow_ref.description: Flow reference — EXR (exchange rates), ICP (HICP), BSI, IRS, STS, BLS, MIR, ...

last_n.description: Return only the last N observations

name: ecb_get_data
